tool_args.rationale: The verified mechanism and pilot signatures point to a five-parameter coupled ODE. The available trajectory batch supplies the additional observations needed to identify it before confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the five-parameter coupled siphon-memory ODE using the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five observations leave the five parameters insufficiently constrained for reliable forecasting.
The auxiliary measurement does not resolve the identified ODE parameter ambiguity.
Their present-snapshot readouts do not account for the observed coupled transient memory signature.
